Requires nauthilus:operations_read. Filters are accepted only in the JSON body; query parameters are refused. HTTP 200 means the call was processed; `source` states the completeness of the log source and `page` the page size the source allowed. Every event carries its timestamp, instance, stream labels, and every field of the log line complete; only authentication secrets (passwords, tokens, keys, cookies, authorization values) are replaced by `<redacted>` and named in `redacted_fields`. Nothing is changed.
